name: Clopimozide
summary: Clopimozide (R-29,764) is a typical antipsychotic drug of the diphenylbutylpiperidine class. It is very potent and has an extremely long duration of action, lasting at least one week with a single dose. It was developed by Janssen Pharmaceutica but was never marketed.

uses.text: It was developed by Janssen Pharmaceutica but was never marketed.

pharmacology.en: Like pimozide, it is thought to work by strongly blocking dopamine D2 receptors in the brain.
pharmacology.zh: 和匹莫齊特一樣，一般認為它是透過強力阻斷大腦中的多巴胺 D2 受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和匹莫齐特一样，一般认为它是通过强力阻断大脑中的多巴胺 D2 受体发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Antipsychotics in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。一般來說，抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、體重增加，以及僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安等動作問題，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。一般来说，抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、头晕、体重增加，以及僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安等动作问题，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: It belongs to the diphenylbutylpiperidines, a family from Janssen that includes pimozide and penfluridol. Some members last so long that they can be taken by mouth just once a week.
fact.zh: 它屬於二苯丁基哌啶類，這是楊森藥廠的藥物家族，包括匹莫齊特與五氟利多。其中有些成員作用時間長到每週只需口服一次。
fact.zhHans: 它属于二苯丁基哌啶类，这是杨森药厂的药物家族，包括匹莫齐特与五氟利多。其中有些成员作用时间长到每周只需口服一次。
